purpose: Protect author voice and narrowly authorized edits in career artifacts without storing personal career content.

source_authority.private_policy: Career Narrative Positioning Standard section 17 (operator-controlled remote Google Doc)
source_authority.current_source: latest provider revision and exact owner comment

runtime.voice_check: Detect known first-person false antithesis and not-just-but templates. Findings indicate a style violation unless user explicitly approves a necessary factual contrast.
runtime.edit_check: Compare before/after paragraph arrays; every changed index must be explicitly authorized by the matching owner comment. Do not silently update adjacent author edits.
runtime.mode: Synthetic CI and optional untracked private JSON input; not a full semantic language model.

proof_ceiling: Detects specified patterns and unapproved line changes only; does not understand arbitrary meaning, access Google Docs comments itself, prove PDF freshness, or authorize factual claims.
